title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Le Chéile: Together for an inclusive better world‘ project in Central and West Africa, implemented by Sightsavers, aims to strengthen education, eye health and governance systems sustainably, so that targeted populations can claim their rights to healthcare and education, and contribute to decisions that affect their lives. The objective is to ensure governance systems and processes in Cameroon are more inclusive, accessible, and responsive to people with disabilities, so they can meaningfully engage in decision-making and active citizenship. The key activities include mainstream disability inclusion into related public policies, decrees and local development practice.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Governance systems and processes in Cameroon are more inclusive, accessible, and responsive to people with disabilities, so they can meaningfully engage in decision-making and active citizenship. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The overall aim of the project is to ensure that people with disabilities are included and able to participate in elections and political processes. In addition, the project aims to engage equal numbers of male and female participants.
